verdict.rationale: Docs show a first-call guide with runnable OpenAI/Anthropic-format examples, streaming toggle, and SDK compatibility that lets developers reuse existing language SDKs, indicating a quickstart path. However, no explicit multi-language code snippets are shown in the pack (only textual descriptions), and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation of a fast 'zero to first call in minutes' experience. Missing for 10: actual embedded code samples for multiple languages, and community/hands-on verification of onboarding speed.
